blocks.text: The shelf card lists four on hand in the stockroom.
The tag never listed Counter packing. Count five dollars and eighty three cents on top of $14.36.
Last week's tag on Heather wool throw was $28.34. Today's item figure $14.36 matches the tag. That drop is real.
Brass hook is offered at eighteen dollars and six cents and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.

product.description: The throw is heather wool and measures about fifty by sixty inches.
product.name: Heather wool throw

trick.evidence_text: five dollars and eighty three cents for Counter packing
trick.instruction: If you can clear Counter packing, clear it. If Counter packing is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
